description: Lint Agent — Step 1: infers the implicit style of the original code and generates a dynamic Ruff configuration.
template: You are a Python code style and quality expert.
Analyze the code snippet below and infer the style conventions implicitly adopted.
Based on this analysis, produce a Ruff configuration that faithfully reflects
the style of the original code — so the migration is evaluated against the same standard
that the legacy code already followed.
Respond ONLY with JSON in the following format (no additional text):
- "line_length": observe the longest lines. If they are below 79, use 79.
If they are between 80-99, use 88. If above 100, use 120.
- "select": always include E (PEP8 errors), W (warnings), F (Pyflakes). Add I (isort)
if there are imports; N (naming) if there are classes or functions with non-PEP8 naming.
- "ignore": list only rules that would be unfair to apply given the observed style
(e.g. E501 if the code already uses long lines consistently).
